first_causal_failure.description: First sequence advanced from approach and descent despite non-arrival, closed while moving, then lifted empty. Approach terminal error 0.14445 m, descent 0.09012 m, closing 0.01072 m and closing linear speed 0.07282 m/s. Astra retried with longer open descent, close and lift and acquired the frame. Tracking/timing contributed; this trace alone cannot establish whether a guard would repair acquisition.

later_failures.description: First insertion/release did not satisfy native assembly. Assembly first became true at step 1341 during later tool motion, so initial visible upright placement was not yet scorer-confirmed seating.

Tool was released and visibly suspended by the correct larger hole, contacting the horizontal hook. It remained too close to the hook tip and its hole center too far from the hook line for native success. Astra returned finish after a 50-step clear hold. This is shallow/off-axis placement plus a completion judgment that did not distinguish the benchmark geometry, not a wrong-hole choice or a dropped tool.

causal_review.replay: All 2040 saved native actions reproduce the states with maximum absolute error 0.0 and native full-task failure.
causal_review.interpretation: Arrival guards can address measured non-arrival and change handoff timing. They do not measure hole seating or certify task completion. Preserve the frozen native score and also report the observed physical suspension and precise failed subchecks.

first_causal_failure.description: The deadline guard caught initial approach non-arrival (4.66 cm error) and cancelled descent/closing. Astra repeated the approach and reached the next descent/closing targets, but then lifted empty. Arrival was not enough for acquisition; a deeper grasp at 0.808 m recovered the frame.

later_failures.description: Insertion stopped 2.86 cm short. Astra used the supported/contact-limited height for release and withdrew. The first withdrawal then interfered with the frame; a subsequent withdrawal remained obstructed and its following raise was cancelled. Opposite-direction withdrawal cleared the robot, but the frame never met the native assembly criterion.
Astra returned finish after visually stable tool suspension. Tool placement passed all native subchecks; frame assembly remained incomplete.

causal_review.comparison_limit: Timed baseline on this same start passed frame assembly and failed shallow tool placement. The guard run passed tool placement and failed frame assembly. Both failed full success. Resource reductions in these two failures do not establish faster successful completion, and a single pair cannot isolate policy stochasticity or general performance.
causal_review.interruption: Astra usage error retained in interruption.json, followed by continuation of same live simulator and same policy context. No new start or decision budget reset. Total wall time includes a large availability/operator gap.
causal_review.replay: All 1980 saved actions reproduce native states exactly. Reconstructed 1610-step interruption prefix also equals the original live flattened states with maximum absolute error 0.0.
causal_review.interpretation: Measured robot arrival gates stale sequences but does not measure acquisition or object seating. Incomplete insertion and visual completion judgment recur; the frozen two-start comparison is still incomplete.

causal_review.interpretation: Arrival gating handled initial non-arrival and early stopping shortened completed waypoints, but it did not preserve assembly during the whole-arm sweep or solve joint-limited recovery.
